operatorAuthorization: Continue focused diagnosis and fixes, selected after mandatory three-attempt HALT
commands: git commit -m "ci: expose actual three-target failures without narrowing the workspace command"
executedWorkspaceStep:
set +e
python3 scripts/run_cgroup_ceiling_17_2.py run --mode delegated --unit maos-17-2-workspace --timeout 5400 --rootless-canary -- cargo test --workspace --locked --no-fail-fast 2>&1 | tee workspace-test-suite.log
pipeline=("${PIPESTATUS[@]}")
result=${pipeline[0]}
if [ "$result" -eq 0 ]; then result=${pipeline[1]}; fi
python3 scripts/17_2_workspace_failure_excerpt.py workspace-test-suite.log
detail=$?
if [ "$result" -eq 0 ]; then result=$detail; fi
WORKSPACE_EXIT="$result" python3 - <<'PY'
import os
status = int(os.environ["WORKSPACE_EXIT"])
if status:
    with open("workspace-test-suite.log", "rb") as log:
        log.seek(0, 2)
        log.seek(max(0, log.tell() - 2800))
        excerpt = log.read(2800).decode(errors="replace")
    excerpt = excerpt.replace("%", "%25").replace("\r", "%0D").replace("\n", "%0A")
    print(f"::error title=17-2 actual workspace failure::exit={status} {excerpt}", flush=True)
else:
    print("::notice title=17-2 actual workspace execution::command=cargo test --workspace --locked --no-fail-fast exit=0", flush=True)
PY
report=$?
if [ "$result" -eq 0 ]; then result=$report; fi
exit "$result"
scope: No production changes, no narrowed test selection, no relaxed cap, count, timeout, privilege, or delegation guarantee
